title: Starting on clarinet in his twenties
summary: He began at about 22-23, encouraged by Isaiah, buying his first clarinet from Albert Nicholson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: I was going to ask you, we might as well get back to that, just when you first took up music, what you started on, and about how old you were.

Oh, when I started out with music, I was about, I guess about 22, 23 years old. Well, you didn't start when you were a little boy then? No, no. I thought with all those musicians in the family, you might have started doing it. Well, no. I was a man when I started trombone this year. Really? I was married when I was taking up music.
Did you ever fool with the instruments when you were a kid though, to blow on your brother's carnet or anything?

Well, no. I never tried to play the carnet, but my brother Isaiah, he did. And after my brother Isaiah started playing music, well then that encouraged me to take up the clarinet. That was your first instrument then? Yeah, my first instrument. And the first clarinet that I bought to start playing on, I bought it from Albert Nicholson.
A clarinet player. Well, he used to play with my brother Sam sometime. And...
What kind of an instrument was it? Albert?
It was Albert's system. Same instrument that I play now, Albert. And out goes the old man Sharleneen, I've taken lessons with old man Sharleneen. I guess you heard of him.
I've heard of him, never got to know him though.
